editorial:
Imagine walking into a fancy office for the job of your dreams, only to find out the interview is a psychological game from hell. You get trapped in a room with six other strangers, all fighting for one high-paying executive spot. You will see a wild mix of people here, like the loud bully, the shy one, and the person who thinks they have it all figured out. The vibe is tense and stressful because the company uses a secret test to weed people out one by one. It feels like a social experiment where you watch people drop their masks and show their ugliest sides just to get ahead in their careers.

What really makes this work is how the tension builds as the group turns on each other. The acting is great because you can feel the panic and greed in the room. While it might feel a bit slow at the start, the twists keep you guessing who will survive the cut. If you like movies that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: At the very end, you find out that the entire test was a trick to see who was the most ruthless. The final candidate thinks they won because they played the game perfectly and stepped on everyone else. However, the company reveals that the real test was about character and ethics. The person who acted the most heartless is actually rejected, proving that the company wanted someone with actual leadership and humanity, not just a cold winner.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and office drama.
